description: September will bring a mix of flagship, foldable and budget smartphones, with launches spread across India, China and global markets. Vivo has two lineups in the pipeline, while Xiaomi and Apple are preparing major flagship releases. Redmi’s new Note models could reach Indian buyers after their international availability, and Poco is set to expand its F series globally. Several launches remain based on reports rather than official announcements, so specifications, pricing and availability could change before the phones arrive later.
title: Smartphones Launching in September 2026: iPhone 18 Pro Lineup, iPhone Ultra, Poco F9 Series and More

description: The smartphone makers launched 23 handsets in India in August 2026. The Google Pixel 11 series was launched in India and other global markets in the first half of August. Moreover, other OEMs unveiled new mid-range handsets, including the Vivo S2, iQOO Z11, Redmi Note 17 5G, Realme 16x 5G, and Realme P4s 5G. The Google Pixel 11 series includes four models, namely Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold. All new Pixel phones feature the latest Tensor G6 chipset.
title: Smartphones Launched in India (August 2026): Google Pixel 11 Series, Realme P4s 5G, Vivo S2, and More

description: The mid-range smartphone segment in India is becoming increasingly competitive. There are several competing brands packing large batteries, high-refresh-rate displays and capable chipsets into phones that cost around Rs. 35,000. The Realme P4s 5G, iQOO Z11 and Nothing Phone (4b) are three recent examples. However, each phone focuses on slightly different aspects. The Realme and iQOO models focus on performance, displays and battery capacity, while the Nothing Phone (4b) has a more design-led approach.
title: Realme P4s vs iQOO Z11 vs Nothing Phone 4b: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Instagram lets users add another layer of protection to their accounts with two-factor authentication. The feature asks for an additional login code when Instagram needs to verify a sign-in, and users can choose an authentication app, text message or WhatsApp as their security method. Setting up 2FA takes only a few steps through the Accounts Center. Users can also turn the feature off later from the same settings. Here is a step-by-step guide to enabling and disabling two-factor authentication on Instagram.
title: How to Secure Your Instagram Account With Two-Factor Authentication

description: Android allows users to recover their recently deleted photos for a specific period of time. Depending on the brand and the UI, Android handsets usually retain deleted images for 30 days. This allows users to restore the photos they deleted from their Android phone by mistake. When a user deletes an image, it is first moved to their phone's Recently Deleted folder. Similarly, users can also recover images that they recently deleted in Google's Photos app. Users can also choose to permanently delete photos from the Recently Deleted folder.
title: How to Recover Deleted Photos on Android: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Answering emails can take up a lot of your workday, especially when dealing with routine questions, follow-ups and requests that do not require a long response. Fortunately, AI can come to your rescue. Claude, Anthropic’s AI assistant, can connect directly to Gmail. The chatbot can analyse email threads, understand their context, and draft replies without requiring you to copy and paste messages into an AI chatbot. It can even send emails on your behalf, but it asks for your approval first by default. This is all made possible by Google Workspace connectors.
title: How to Use Claude to Automatically Reply to Emails in Gmail: A Step-by-Step Guide
